arguments.message: I'm sorry to hear about your cat. I can help you with changing your flight. To get started, could you please provide me with your user ID and, if you have it, your reservation ID?

resultat: Thank you. My user ID is daiki_lee_6144. I don't have my reservation ID, unfortunately.

arguments.message:

resultat: I need to change the first one, the round trip from JFK to DTW on May 17th. I'd like to change the outbound flight to a nonstop flight.

arguments.message:
I'm sorry, but this reservation is booked in **basic economy**, and basic economy flights cannot be modified under our policy. That includes changing the outbound flight to a nonstop option.

Is there anything else I can help you with — for example, with one of your other reservations?

resultat: That's really inconvenient. I understand the policy, but my situation is a bit urgent. Is there absolutely no way to change it, even with a fee? I'm willing to pay up to $100 for the change, but I don't want to buy a whole new flight.

arguments.message:
I completely understand your frustration, and I'm sorry about your urgent situation. Unfortunately, basic economy tickets cannot be modified in any way — this includes changing to a nonstop flight, and it applies regardless of any fee you're willing to pay. I'm not able to make an exception to this policy.

The only change permitted on a basic economy reservation is a cabin class change (without changing the flights themselves), which wouldn't accomplish what you're looking for.

I'm sorry I can't be more helpful here. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

resultat: This is really difficult. So, just to be clear, there's no option at all to change my existing flight to a nonstop one, even if I pay a fee under $100? I'm not looking to buy a new flight entirely.

arguments.message:
That's correct — I'm sorry. On a basic economy reservation, there is no option to change your existing flight to a nonstop one, at any fee. Our policy does not permit flight modifications on basic economy tickets, and I'm unable to make an exception.

The only thing that can be changed on this reservation is the cabin class, and only without altering the flights themselves.

I understand this is difficult given your situation. Is there anything else I can help you with?
